pages.zh: AI将成为普通人的最后一次创业风口
pages.en: AI will be the last major entrepreneurial opportunity for ordinary people.

pages.zh: 我看好的是在兰州这个三线城市用自己熟悉的行业
pages.en: What I see promise in is using the industry you already know in Lanzhou, a third-tier city.

pages.zh: 加上AI就是降维打击
pages.en: Add AI, and it becomes an asymmetric advantage.

pages.zh: 既能服务本地也能尝试接外地的业务
pages.en: You can serve local clients and also try taking work from elsewhere.

pages.zh: 你以前干过什么
pages.en: What have you done before?

pages.zh: 帮别人做到了哪一步
pages.en: How far have you helped others get?

pages.zh: 这些差别到AI这里不会自动消失
pages.en: AI will not automatically erase those differences.

pages.zh: 收入上的差距反而可能因此拉开
pages.en: The income gap may widen because of them.

pages.zh: 所以我以前做过销售开过店
pages.en: I used to work in sales and ran a shop.

pages.zh: 或者是在一个行业里面干了很多年
pages.en: Or you may have spent years in one industry.

pages.zh: 别觉得学AI了就要把这些全扔掉
pages.en: Do not think learning AI means throwing all of that away.

pages.zh: 从头转行
pages.en: And changing careers from scratch.

pages.zh: 我对客户的了解恰恰可能派上用场
pages.en: Your understanding of customers may be exactly what becomes useful.

pages.zh: 咱们就帮本地的老板做内容来说
pages.en: Take helping local business owners create content.

pages.zh: 你让AI写一句品质好服务好谁都能写
pages.en: Anyone can ask AI to write "good quality, good service."

pages.zh: 客户看完还是不知道为什么选这家
pages.en: But customers still will not know why they should choose this business.

pages.zh: 但老板平时怎么回答客户他手里有哪些东西
pages.en: How does the owner usually answer customers, and what resources do they have?

pages.zh: 为什么价格不一样什么人适合这个产品
pages.en: Why are prices different, and who is this product for?

pages.zh: 哪些要求确实做不到
pages.en: Which requests genuinely cannot be met?

pages.zh: 这些问题他可能已经解释过了很多遍
pages.en: They may already have explained these questions many times.

pages.zh: 你可以帮他把这些回答收集起来
pages.en: You can help collect those answers.

pages.zh: 用AI归类理顺
pages.en: Use AI to categorize and organize them.

pages.zh: 然后改成适合拍视频的文稿再由老板核对
pages.en: Then turn them into video-ready scripts for the owner to verify.

pages.zh: 配上能公开的产品和服务资料一条条的讲出去
pages.en: Add product and service materials that can be made public, and explain them one by one.

pages.zh: AI承担整理和制作的部分工作
pages.en: AI handles part of the organizing and production.

pages.zh: 内容的底子还是老板自己做过的生意
pages.en: But the foundation is still the business the owner has actually done.

pages.zh: 以前这些经验可能只有进过店跟他聊过的客户才知道
pages.en: In the past, perhaps only customers who visited and talked with the owner knew this experience.

pages.zh: 现在有机会让没有来过的人也看到
pages.en: Now people who have never visited may also see it.

pages.zh: 搜相关问题的时候也能找到他的介绍
pages.en: And find the owner's explanation when searching related questions.

pages.zh: 这种内容不一定每条都要追着爆
pages.en: Not every piece of content has to chase a viral hit.

pages.zh: 一个本地客户先看懂的是你的产品
pages.en: A local customer first understands your product.

pages.zh: 再看见你怎么处理问题
pages.en: Then sees how you handle problems.

pages.zh: 慢慢的对你有了印象
pages.en: And gradually remembers you.

pages.zh: 等他真有需要的时候
pages.en: When they genuinely need help,

pages.zh: 你才有机会进去他的选择
pages.en: you then have a chance to enter their consideration.

pages.zh: 这既是老板可以尝试的内容做法
pages.en: This is a content approach a business owner can try.

pages.zh: 也是懂这个行业的人留出了一种服务机会
pages.en: It also creates a service opportunity for someone who understands the industry.

pages.zh: 你帮他把经验讲清楚持续做成内容
pages.en: You help explain the owner's experience clearly and keep turning it into content.

pages.zh: 省下他自己摸索和制作的功夫
pages.en: Saving them the effort of figuring out and producing everything alone.

pages.zh: 但他本身没有能交给客户的产品和服务
pages.en: But if they have no product or service to deliver to customers,

pages.zh: 光发内容也接不住生意
pages.en: content alone cannot capture the business.

pages.zh: 如果你能听懂一个行业的问题
pages.en: If you can understand an industry's problems,

pages.zh: 也能把约定的工作做好
pages.en: and deliver the work you agreed to do,

pages.zh: 就可以试着把这项服务介绍给外地同行
pages.en: you can try introducing this service to peers in other places.

pages.zh: 同样需要整理客户问题制作产品内容的人
pages.en: To people who also need to organize customer questions and produce product content.

pages.zh: 远程接业务早就有了
pages.en: Remote work has existed for a long time.

pages.zh: 不是AI才发明的
pages.en: AI did not invent it.

pages.zh: AI增加的可能性是帮一个人一个小团队
pages.en: What AI adds is the possibility for one person or a small team

pages.zh: 多承担一些过去做不过来的整理和制作工作
pages.en: to take on more organizing and production work than they previously could.

pages.zh: 至于客户怎么找到你
pages.en: As for how clients find you,

pages.zh: 为什么信你还得靠你自己的作品和服务
pages.en: and why they trust you, that still depends on your own work and service.

pages.zh: 这么一想留在兰州就不止有本地能给我多少岗位
pages.en: Seen this way, staying in Lanzhou is no longer only about how many jobs the city offers me.

pages.zh: 这一个问题了
pages.en: That is no longer the only question.

pages.zh: 还可以想我会做的这些事外地有没有人需要
pages.en: I can also ask whether people elsewhere need what I know how to do.

pages.zh: 如果你的住处生活已经在这里了
pages.en: If your home and life are already here,

pages.zh: 留在本地能少一些搬迁和生活开支
pages.en: staying local can reduce moving and living costs.

pages.zh: 那省下来的钱就能给找客户改作品磨合服务
pages.en: The money saved can go toward finding clients, improving your work, and refining the service.

pages.zh: 多留一点时间
pages.en: Giving you a little more time.

pages.zh: 很多事情要做了改了才知道适合不适合继续
pages.en: Many things only reveal whether they are worth continuing after you try and revise them.

pages.zh: 刚开始没有结果的时候手里还有没有余地很重要
pages.en: When results have not arrived yet, having some room left matters.

pages.zh: 我自己学AI课程会员调用费用
pages.en: I spend money learning AI—courses, memberships, and usage fees.

pages.zh: 做图做视频的成本都要花
pages.en: Creating images and videos also costs money.

pages.zh: 做出来不适合还得继续改
pages.en: If the result does not fit, it has to be revised again.

pages.zh: 所以我不会把这条路讲成一台电脑零成本创业
pages.en: So I will not describe this as starting a business with one computer and zero cost.

pages.zh: 钱花的少一些只是让你有机会多试几次
pages.en: Spending a little less simply gives you more chances to try.

pages.zh: 客户如果自己也会用AI了他还需要你做什么
pages.en: If clients can use AI themselves, what do they still need you for?

pages.zh: 你得听懂老板说的麻烦
pages.en: You need to understand the owner's real problem.

pages.zh: 不能他一说生意不好你就给他生成一份通用方案
pages.en: You cannot generate a generic plan the moment they say business is slow.

pages.zh: AI给出的内容也得看得出哪里不符合实际
pages.en: You must also spot where AI-generated content does not fit reality.

pages.zh: 到了收服务费的时候还要把做哪些工作
pages.en: When charging a service fee, you must clarify what work will be done.

pages.zh: 谁配合交什么东西讲清楚
pages.en: Who will cooperate, and what must be delivered.

pages.zh: 客户拿到以后用不上你得继续查问题
pages.en: If the client cannot use the result, you need to keep investigating the problem.

pages.zh: 而且工具越来越容易用
pages.en: And tools are becoming easier to use.

pages.zh: 只靠生成几段文字几张图片收费以后可能更难
pages.en: Charging only for a few generated paragraphs or images may become harder.

pages.zh: 老板自己也能试你得比他自己试多承担一些他没时间做
pages.en: Owners can try AI themselves, so you must take on more of the work they lack time to do.

pages.zh: 不会检查没有办法持续做下去的工作
pages.en: Work they cannot check or sustain.

pages.zh: 咱们在本地可以去店里聊
pages.en: Locally, we can visit shops and talk.

pages.zh: 看看他们平时到底怎么干
pages.en: See how they actually work day to day.

pages.zh: 把这些情况问明白才知道网上那些通用方案哪些地方在这家店根本用不了
pages.en: Only after understanding this can we know which generic online plans simply do not work for that shop.

pages.zh: 能不能帮上忙得按照实际情况改
pages.en: Whether we can help depends on adapting to the actual situation.

pages.zh: 我已经做过企业AI应用和GEO的付费项目也做过交付
pages.en: I have completed paid business AI application and GEO projects, including delivery.

pages.zh: 这是我愿意继续做下去的一个原因
pages.en: That is one reason I want to keep doing this.

pages.zh: 但有个交付不等于生意已经做完了
pages.en: But one delivery does not mean the business is finished.

pages.zh: 接下来就是服务怎么做好客户能不能持续用还得下工夫
pages.en: We still need to improve the service and see whether clients can keep using it.

pages.zh: 你有工作就先在熟悉的业务里面
pages.en: If you have a job, start with the business you already know.

pages.zh: 你已经做着生意可以看看哪些经验还没让客户知道
pages.en: If you are already running a business, see which experience your customers still do not know.

pages.zh: 完全没接触过一个行业的人先去了解实际工作
pages.en: If you have never worked in an industry, first learn how the real work is done.

pages.zh: 别因为AI能给方案就着急给老板当顾问
pages.en: Do not rush to advise business owners just because AI can generate a plan.

pages.zh: 我选择留在兰州做这件事
pages.en: I choose to stay in Lanzhou and do this.

pages.zh: 把本地企业的问题弄明白
pages.en: Understand the problems of local businesses.

pages.zh: 把自己能承担的工作做好再去争取更多的客户
pages.en: Do the work I can take responsibility for, then seek more clients.

pages.zh: 咱们兰州的老板需要做企业AI应用
pages.en: Business owners in Lanzhou who need business AI applications

pages.zh: 可以来找我带着实际碰到的问题
pages.en: can come talk to me with the real problems they face.

pages.zh: 咱们聊一聊我能参与哪一段哪些还做不了
pages.en: We can discuss which part I can help with and what I still cannot do.

pages.zh: 咱们当面说清楚
pages.en: We will make that clear face to face.

pages.zh: 我是超哥在兰州AI创业
pages.en: I am Chao, building an AI business in Lanzhou.

mainVisualBeats.coreMeaning: 开场是个人趋势判断，未证实最后一次；不配不可逆淘汰或财富倒计时。
本人看好熟悉行业加AI服务本地、尝试外地；不是收益承诺。
既有经历和服务能力的差别不会因同用AI自动消失。
销售、开店等经历中的客户了解可继续使用，不是学AI就归零。
通用赞美句不能讲清这家产品为什么适合客户。
老板对价格、适用人群和能力边界的回答才是内容原料。
老板回答经过AI整理和老板核对后，才作为对外内容讲出去。
经验有机会被更多人看见，不等于搜索推荐或曝光必达。
理解、印象与真实需求可能形成选择机会，不保证成交。
只有内容而无产品或服务，不能接住客户的生意。
具备行业理解和履约能力后，可以尝试向外地同行介绍服务。
AI增加整理制作的承载能力，客户信任仍依赖作品和服务。
人在兰州可以主动调查外地是否有人需要自己会做的事。
已有本地生活条件可能节省开支、留出试错时间；不是人人更便宜。
真实学习制作有成本，省一些钱只能多留几次尝试，不是零成本。
提问转场：客户会用AI以后，服务还承担什么。
谈清工作范围、协作和交付；用不上时仍需查问题。
服务需承担客户没时间做、不会检查和难持续的工作。
到店了解实际情况后，才知道通用方案哪里不适用。
本人已有付费交付但不等于已经营稳定，不虚构客户或收入。
先在熟悉业务中练习，未了解行业不能急着给老板当顾问。
本人留在兰州继续服务，明确能承担与做不了的边界。
